title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Why is this office so damn cold?! Hey, you there! You okay with me using that for kindling?

title: Talk 1
original: Oh, How much did you say this book costs? Haha, pricey. Call me Mistress Ifrit and I'll give it back to you.

title: Talk 2
original: Huh? You want me to read this book? I hate it when people try to tell me… It's from Silence? Really? Urgh... Wha-what does this word mean here?

title: Talk 3
original: I hate it when you white coat creepers stare at me... Yeah, I mean you! What'cha looking at? Go stare at something else!

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Um... Okay, fine. No more scaring people with fire.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Back off! You... Why are you coming at me like that? You wanna strap me to a lab table too?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Saria's here? I want to see her— Silence says no? C'mon, what's the big deal? Just take me to her and keep it off the record!

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Why are Silence and Saria arguing all the time? I don't get it... Hey! You gotta know how to get them to make up, right? C'mon, just tell me… I mean, please...?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: I don't care what you think of me, but you'd better be nice to Silence. When she wants something, you go get it for her! Do that, and your wish is my command.

title: Idle
original: You little...! You've got guts to ignore me and slack off like this!

title: Onboard
original: You stand before the almighty Ifrit! Hmph, Silence says Rhodes Island's a nice place, but there's nothing I hate more than you white-coat science creepers... I mean, except Silence...

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Stronger...? Hmm, that means my flames can burn brighter, right?

title: Promotion 1
original: What's this? Promotion Manual for Rhodes Island Operators? Guess I'll give it a peek... What the hell? So many rules even after I get promoted? Nah-uh, pass.

title: Promotion 2
original: Haha, that's right! I don't give a damn about all those rules. But, if you say you're counting on me, then that's all the words I need!

title: Added to Squad
original: Yeah yeah, I heard ya.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: I'm the captain? So, just do like Silence would, right?

title: Depart
original: Hey! They made me the captain, so I'm the one calling the shots here!

title: Begin Operation
original: Yo! How 'bout another barbecue!

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Hey!

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Too slow!

title: Deployment 1
original: Let the world BURN!

title: Deployment 2
original: Hellfire, locked and loaded!

title: In Battle 1
original: Does it hurt? I bet it does!

title: In Battle 2
original: Hahaha! Keep screaming!

title: In Battle 3
original: Shriek all you want! Nobody cares!

title: In Battle 4
original: Get in the line of death!

title: 4-star Result
original: Weak, you're all too weak! I am invincibllllle!

title: 3-star Result
original: Why don't we torch all the trash into kindling? It'll be nice and warm!

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Nothing but cinders left now. I could've handled this all by myself!

title: Operation Failure
original: Damn you... You made a fool out of me!

title: Assigned to Facility
original: What kind of place is this? Huh?

title: Tap
original: The hell are you doing here?

title: Trust Tap
original: Heheh, you're nicer than I expected. Wanna hang out?

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: New Year's? Hah, no sweat, Silence taught me about New Year's forever ago. You celebrate all of last year, and make your resolutions or whatever for next year! My resolutions? Hey, what's with the homework? Silence said I don't have to do any today! Beat it!

title: Greeting
original: You need something?

title: Birthday
original: Feast your eyes on the great Ifrit's handmade chocolate cake! Silence taught me, and I got it right on the first try! I know, I know, I'm the best! ...Wh-What the hell? How come it melted?

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: What's the deal outside today, why's it so noisy? Whoooa, there's a party! Is there a barbecue? I'm really good at barbecue, everyone should come eat mine! Which means, it's time to stoke the fire… What? We're not doing it on a charcoal grill? Boring! Where'd my grill go? Shaw confiscated it? Arrrrrrgh—
